name: Booster T2 Pro High-DoF Tactile
summary: A 1.4 m two-legged research humanoid with two 21-DOF tactile hands and NVIDIA Thor compute, for fine manipulation research.

sellers.note: "Sofort verfügbar", delivery about 4 weeks in Germany. Article 101004.
sellers.name: Bipedal GmbH

sellers.note: RBTX shows 99,999 EUR excl. VAT, but its title says Jetson AGX Orin 32GB, 200 TOPS while its text says NVIDIA Thor, 2000 TOPS. Confirm the compute before comparing prices.
sellers.name: RBTX marketplace (igus SE & Co. KG)

sellers.note: Lists it as Pro P3-3 with BrainCo Revo3 U21T hands; price only after choosing the version.
sellers.name: Generation Robots

germany.statusNote: Bipedal (Leverkusen) sells this configuration at 126,677 EUR incl. VAT with a cart button, shown as immediately available with about 4 weeks delivery. Generation Robots lists it as Pro P3-3. The RBTX listing has a different price and a conflicting compute title, so its price is not used.

specs.label: DOF per hand
specs.conditions: fully backdrivable, tactile sensing across the whole hand

specs.label: Payload per arm
specs.conditions: RBTX listing, same as the plain T2 Pro; Bipedal states 5 kg horizontal for this version

specs.label: Payload both arms
specs.conditions: maximum dual-arm payload, T2 maker page, depends on posture

specs.label: Speed
specs.conditions: RBTX and Generation Robots; maker states 3 m/s walking for T2

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Head and waist depth cameras, wrist cameras, microphone array, 9-axis IMU

specs.label: Software
specs.value: ROS 2 and SDK, Python or C++

capabilities.sdk: ROS 2, SDK in Python or C++
notes: Hands are BrainCo Revo3 U21T according to Generation Robots.
Payload per arm is 3 kg on RBTX and 5 kg on Bipedal; the lower value is used.
Generation Robots states movement on steps and slopes for T2; the maker makes no stair claim.
Delivered with one battery pack, charger, remote and transport case.
